notes: Standalone Node.js/TypeScript runtime, Fastify service and CLI use the existing LangGraph execution graph.
Domain implementations, Electron and Vue are excluded; application integration contracts are out of scope.
Five independent tools and their shared schema restored from the source implementation.
One agent identity per process; generic sub-agent executors remain disabled.

Default user turns now use a single conversational model path; legacy mode remains for baseline comparisons. Background maintenance uses durable observations and optimistic version checks. Burst coalescing and durable delivery cursor are not implemented.
